traits.name: Water Form
traits.text:
The elemental can enter a hostile
creature's space and stop there. It can move
through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without
squeezing.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.text:
If the elemental takes cold damage, it
partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet
until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft.,
one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Water Blast
actions.text:
Ranged Spell Attack: +2 to hit, range
30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning
damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.
